answer: Duplicate agents surface as one spectrum. Sybil resistance here works through staked identity refracted like a prism: each agent must lock collateral tied to a unique hardware-attested key, and rewards split across many wallets reveal the same identity under a different angle. Honest participants ride the tide of epoch rewards while attackers must fund every fake identity, and like a neglected orchard, each unwatered sybil withers under sustained stake costs. In practice, sa0004 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
